payload.title: The edge agent release builds with cross, whose container does not contain the repository-root workspace manifest that crates/alarm-core inherits from, so every release build fails while cargo loads the manifest; the break has been latent since 2026-07-13 because no pull-request job builds with cross, and agent-v2.0.0-rc.6 failed all three builds
evidence: sens-api-gateway/Cargo.toml:23 (alarm-core is a path dependency outside the agent project: ../crates/alarm-core, added by 400fbf234 on 2026-07-13)
crates/alarm-core/Cargo.toml:3-9 (version, edition, rust-version, authors, license, repository and publish are all inherited from the workspace, e.g. edition.workspace = true)
Cargo.toml:18-19 (the repository-root workspace excludes sens-api-gateway, so the agent is its own workspace and the root manifest is not part of its build graph)
.github/workflows/edge-agent-release.yml:244 (the release builds with cross build from the sens-api-gateway directory; no job before a tag builds with cross)
sens-api-gateway/Cross.toml:12-30 (the container is given the project and the passthrough variables; nothing mounts the repository root)
payload.rule_violated: A release path must be exercised before a tag exists, and a crate the agent depends on must be buildable inside the release container: cross mounts the project and its path dependencies' own directories, so a path dependency that inherits from a workspace needs that workspace root mounted too.
payload.notes: Run 40668157738 (tag agent-v2.0.0-rc.6, 3a0cce89c): Release ref contract and Sens enterprise validation passed, all three Build jobs failed in Build release binary with error inheriting edition from workspace root manifest, Create GitHub Release was skipped and nothing was published. Reproduced with the real cross 0.2.5 container: exit 101 with the identical error without the mount, exit 0 with the repository root mounted. Close condition: Cross.toml mounts the repository root through [build.env] volumes, the release job exports it, the version is 2.0.0-rc.7 so a new tag can be cut (a tag cannot be moved), and tests/invariants/edge-release-cross-workspace-root.spec.ts fails when the mount or its export is removed while a path dependency inherits from a workspace.
